warrants.quote: As of June 30, 2025, all 3,100,823 pre-funded warrants remain outstanding.
Each pre-funded warrant has an exercise price of $0.0001, is exercisable at any time after the date of issuance for one share of common stock, and will expire when exercised in full.
Each Common Warrant has an exercise price of $1.0846, is exercisable at any time after the date of Closing
